# Briefly

> Briefly is a productized web design service run by David Cruz. You choose what you need, answer a short brief, and receive a custom-built, professional website in one business day: no meetings, no templates, no agency overhead. Fixed price.

## About
- A one-person studio by David Cruz, a digital designer with 16 years of experience, based in Loures, Portugal.
- Works with clients worldwide (PT and EN).
- You work directly with David from brief to delivery: full accountability, no account managers.

## What Briefly does
- Custom landing page design and build, delivered in one business day.
- Hand-coded HTML: responsive, accessible (WCAG AA), SEO-optimised and fast (Core Web Vitals).
- One round of revisions included.
- Delivered as a clean, ready-to-publish file that you own and can host anywhere, no lock-in.

## What Briefly does NOT do
- No templates or page builders (no Webflow, Framer, Squarespace).
- No CMS / back-office, no dynamic web apps.
- No ongoing maintenance unless a monthly support plan is added.

## Pricing
- Landing page: EUR 497, one-time.
- Extra pages: +EUR 149 per page (up to 3), adds ~24h each.
- Domain & hosting setup: +EUR 89, one-time.
- Monthly support: EUR 49/month (updates and tweaks).

## Process
1. Send the brief (under 5 minutes): pick the package, describe the project, share references.
2. Briefly designs and builds the site from scratch, no templates.
3. Delivered the next business day, ready to publish.
